name: io.github.sv/triz
title: TRIZ
description: Deterministic, read-only TRIZ knowledge: the 39 engineering parameters, 40 inventive principles, and the Altshuller contradiction matrix with fail-closed blank cells — plus stage-based tool routing, an effects database, and blinded MATRIZ case evals. Agents cite looked-up principles, never recalled ones.
